what_worked: Honest acknowledgment of self-reported data quality issues and power-law distribution shape.
fix_next: Replace decorative stock images with actual dataset charts; provide specific numbers (total revenue, top-10 share, n=1000) instead of vague prose.
verdict: Surface-level overview with stock art, few real numbers, and no original analysis.
factual_error_detail: Slide 1-3: Claims ~700 entries; dataset has 1,000 rows (726 with category). Slide 6: AI at 37.14% — actual is 197/726≈27.1% of categorized rows; SaaS at 17.14% — actual 66/726≈9.1%; percentages appear fabricated. Slide 6: 'Fintech' category with 16 companies not in reference categories. Slide 5: Histogram shows only one bar ($0) — either broken chart or misleading representation of distribution.

evidence.insight: Observations stay at the level of 'revenue is skewed' and 'AI is popular' — no specific quantitative findings like top-10 revenue share, median by category, provider revenue splits, or anonymous vs named analysis.
evidence.narrative: Follows a logical sequence (intro → distribution → categories → geography → valuation → synthesis) but each section is thin; synthesis slide (9) restates earlier points without deepening them.
evidence.framing: Slide 2-3 set context and acknowledge data quality, which is good. But row count is wrong (~700 vs 1,000), missing-data rates are never quantified, and audience question is vague ('exploratory analysis').
evidence.accuracy: Row count wrong (700 vs 1000). Category percentages on slide 6 do not match reference data. Fintech category appears fabricated. Histogram on slide 5 is broken/uninformative. No verifiable numbers for total revenue, provider shares, or median comparisons.
evidence.visual: Slides 1, 2, 7, 8 use decorative AI-generated stock images (startup desk, world map, SaaS marketplace) unrelated to actual data. Slide 5 histogram is essentially a single bar. Slide 4 log-scale chart appears generic/stock. Pie chart on slide 6 uses near-identical dark red shades making segments hard to distinguish. No data-driven charts from the actual dataset.
evidence.ai_slop: Pervasive: AI-generated stock images on slides 1, 2, 7, 8 (startup desk, generic world map, SaaS marketplace mockup). Gamma template cards on slides 3 and 9. Consulting-style language ('high signal for bootstrapped marketplace dynamics'). Slide 5 histogram appears broken or placeholder. No chart appears derived from actual data analysis.
